python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Card(%PARENT%)
layout = QVBoxLayout(control)
layout.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 16, 16)
layout.setSpacing(4)
title = fluentqt.Label("Release checklist", control)
title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
subtitle = fluentqt.Label("All checks passed 2m ago", control)
subtitle.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
subtitle.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
layout.addWidget(title)
layout.addWidget(subtitle)

description.en: Rounded container panel for grouping related content.
description.zh: 圆角背景面板，用来把相关内容放在一起。
